remarks: Charming Village Rental in the Heart of New Canaan. Exceptional oppurtunity to rent right in the heart of town, offering unmatched convenience to the village's dining, boutique shopping, and just a half mile to Metro-North commuter rail. The main level features a comfortable living room and kitchen, ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Three well-appointed bedrooms and a full bath complete the upper level. A convenient half bath serves the main floor. Enjoy outdoor living on a private deck, plus additional storage or flex space in the unfinished lower level. A rare chance to experience the best of New Canaan village life. Bedrooms: 3 | Bathrooms: 1.5 | Features: Deck, Unfinished Lower Level | Location: Village Center
